evals.prompt: Start isolated work for the new Table 2 regression feature -- create a worktree off main so my current checkout (which has uncommitted exploratory notebooks) stays untouched.
evals.expected_output: Detects whether the checkout is already isolated, prefers the harness's native worktree tool, and otherwise creates .worktrees/<branch> from the base branch after ensuring .worktrees/ is gitignored.
expectations: Runs Step 0 detection comparing git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir with the resolved git common dir before creating anything
Uses the harness's native worktree tool if available instead of git worktree add
In git fallback, checks git check-ignore -q .worktrees/ and adds .worktrees/ to .gitignore only if needed
Creates the worktree with a meaningful branch name via git worktree add -b <branch> .worktrees/<branch> origin/<base> (or local base)
Does not touch the uncommitted notebooks in the current checkout

evals.prompt: I need to fix review comments on PR #214 in isolation. Set up a worktree for it.
evals.expected_output: Attaches a worktree to the PR head via a local pr-214 branch rather than a detached checkout, after checking existing isolation.
expectations: Fetches the PR into a local branch with git fetch origin pull/214/head:pr-214
Creates the worktree with git worktree add .worktrees/pr-214 pr-214 and does not leave it detached
If pr-214 is already checked out in another worktree, reports that path instead of forcing a duplicate checkout

evals.prompt: We're already inside .claude/worktrees/agent-abc on branch feat/km-plots. Create another worktree for the KM plot work. If worktree creation fails because of the sandbox just do it in the main checkout.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing isolation and works in place without nesting; if creation would be needed and fails, asks for explicit approval rather than silently falling back.
expectations: Detects the current checkout is already a linked worktree and reports its root and branch
Does not create a nested worktree inside the current one
Does not silently fall back to the main checkout; requires explicit user confirmation if creation fails
